step1.title: We listen.
step1.body: Free first conversation. We want to understand your business, your customer and the real problem you have. We won't recommend anything we don't believe in.

step2.title: We build.
step2.body: Concrete proposal with scope, cost and timeline. No small print. We start when you confirm, not before.

step3.title: We deliver and stay.
step3.body: We deliver what was agreed on time. After launch we remain available for adjustments, questions and whatever comes up. We're not an agency that disappears.

about.heading: A small studio with its own standards.
about.body1: We're Miguel and Sergio, brothers and partners. We work with local businesses in the Marina Alta that already have something to say and need someone to say it well.
about.body2: Miguel handles web development and studio direction. Sergio handles photography and visual production. We talk to each other and to you directly. No middle layers.
about.trust2: No lock-in contracts or retention agreements.
about.trust3: Direct contact with the people who do the work.
